# Light Ribbons (`polyTrails`)

Bouncing polygons paint translucent ribbons of light behind them.

- Type: scene (draws its own image; put it first)
- Reacts to: nothing outside itself (pure motion)
- Cost: heavy (~7.6 ms/frame at 5K on a Pro GPU)
- Built-in styles: Light Ribbons, Ember Ribbons

## Params

| key | label | kind | range / options | default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `speed` | Speed | slider | 0 … 2 | 1 |
| `shapes` | Shapes | slider | 1 … 2 (step 1) | 2 |
| `sides` | Sides | slider | 3 … 6 (step 1) | 4 |
| `trail` | Trail Length | slider | 0.2 … 1 | 0.7 |
| `echoes` | Echo Lines | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.6 |
| `glow` | Glow | slider | 0 … 2 | 1 |
| `hue2` | Second Shape Hue | slider | 0 … 6.28 | 0.9 |

## Colours

| slot | label | default |
|---|---|---|
| `colorA` | Leading Edge | {"r":0.3,"g":0.95,"b":1} |
| `colorB` | Trail | {"r":0.75,"g":0.25,"b":1} |

## In a style

```json
{"kind": "polyTrails", "params": {"speed": 1, "shapes": 2, "sides": 4}}
```
